holder-quote: The Drake sighed. He turned, spreading the smile to Lyonette and Mrsha, who’d both come to stare at him. Erin was impressed; when Teliv saw Numbtongue he only froze up for a microsecond. Then he just smiled at the Hobgoblin. He was pretty good.

“Teliv Witherscale, at your service. I’m a part-time [Host] working at Wishdrinks—let me know, anytime, and I’ll be happy to work for any crowd, group, or smaller party! I do dinner-parties too, and I can even liven up a birthday or level-up party! I don’t do funerals.”
Teliv the Drake [Host] and sometimes [Negotiator] jumped at Erin’s voice.
